featured_reviews.name: Shah Rukh Pawaskar
featured_reviews.review_text: Working from Workbay has been a fantastic experience. The space is modern, well maintained, and perfect for productivity. Great ambiance, reliable facilities and a very very supportive team to take care of you. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a professional and comfortable co working environment..

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Ahire
featured_reviews.review_text:
Workbay has been an absolute delight to work from! The atmosphere here strikes the perfect balance between professional and relaxed. The seating is comfortable, well-arranged, and ideal for long working hours. I especially love the small lawn-side sitting area—it adds a refreshing, open-air vibe that’s perfect for a quick break or a change of scenery.

A special mention to Sundar, who is truly the soul of this place. Always approachable, kind, and ready to help with anything you need, he makes working here even better. Whether it’s sorting out small issues or simply greeting you with a smile, Sundar ensures everyone feels welcome and taken care of.

Highly recommend Workbay for anyone looking for a productive yet pleasant co-working experience!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Greetings from Workbay. Thank you so much for your kind and honest words. We are glad you are truly enjoying the essence and balance of coworking at Workbay.

featured_reviews.name: Shampa Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Love this workspace! Perfect blend of outdoors and indoors with open seating and cozy cabins. Ideal for freelancers and teams. Positive vibes, natural light, and comfortable amenities make it a productivity haven. The interiors is also perfectly designed with bright decor.  The garden area is unlike any other work place. And the coffee is too good.
Feels like a community, not just a workspace. Highly recommended.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your kind words! We are so glad you enjoyed your time at Workbay and appreciate you taking the time to share your experience.

featured_reviews.name: Imaan Rojoa
featured_reviews.review_text: The atmosphere is vibrant, professional, and full of great energy. It’s the perfect environment for productivity and networking. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a well-designed workspace!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your kind words! We are thrilled to hear that you felt the vibrant and professional energy we strive to create at Workbay. It means a lot to know that the space is supporting your productivity and helping you connect with others. We are so glad to have you as part of the community.

featured_reviews.name: Ruben Lobo
featured_reviews.review_text:
Totally in love with this place ! The ambience, the location, the people around. Everything is so good! A big thank you to Sundar Iyer for giving all the members such wonderful hospitality since day 1. I came here to experience a change in my work routine and this place will certainly give you a positive vibe to work efficiently.
The community manager here, Barkha, is really sweet and has ensured that she keeps everyone engaged through various activities
Workbay is not just a co-working space but much more than that. Check it out for yourselves by visiting the place once.
P.S. The filter coffee here is amazing!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi Ruben. Thank you so much for your complete experience review . We are glad to have members like you on board who are thoroughly enjoying working out of our space. We work really hard and are happy that we are consistently achieving the same.

featured_reviews.name: Felix Vietinghoff
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great time here! The location is perfect, the desks are nice and comfy but most importantly, the community of members is so cool. It's a mix of accomplished entrepreneurs and people starting out. There is a very positive vibe and people interact a lot with each other. If it's over lunch or the afternoon tea, there is always a chance to catch up and laugh a bit. The day I arrived, a monthly event was happening, where everybody brought lunch typical for his/her hometown for sharing. The food was amazing and it was the perfect way to connect with each other. The host and one of the owners Sundar is doing a great job of facilitating these  encounters and the overall vibe in general. You can feel that they've put a lot of thought into the concept and the community. When I had to leave after my two weeks in Mumbai, they organized another goodbye lunch which was just as tasty an unforgettable as the first one. It's definitely my co-working place of choice when coming to Mumbai the next time.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Felix,
Greetings from Workbay. Thank you for the heartfelt review. We are glad that you felt so at home even in the short time you spent. Looking forward to seeing you around whenever you are visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Himani
featured_reviews.review_text: I have worked from here twice. The staff and the manager are courteous and helpful. The place is good, it's clean and hygienic. The only problem is that the people around you will sometimes be really loud. But that's a people problem, it is not a place problem. I highly recommend that you book your co-working from here once.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Himani,
Greetings from Workbay. Thank you for an honest review. But that is what makes the vibe of the Coworking space. The people in it. We are glad you liked the overall experience. Looking forward to seeing you soon.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsh Dalal
featured_reviews.review_text:
First things first, the staff both at the building and at the coworking space were polite and lovely. However, that is the only positive thing I have to say. This may be the worst coworking space I have ever been to, and I'm genuinely shocked that they even market it as a coworking space.

What it is is a glorified cafe - if you get a day pass and try to work here, they shove you into a random table in the corner of their lunch room (picture attached), with uncomfortable and unergonomic chairs. My shoulder started hurting within a few minutes of sitting here.

Since it is their lunch room, it's also not quiet - so not suitable for working, and definitely not suitable for taking calls or meetings. There is no room for taking calls.

There is coffee and water, but you have to take it in a tiny paper cup (photo attached). I don't think they even had crockery or cutlery to eat lunch with.

To make matters worse, the address they send of the location on Google Maps is wrong (wrong side of the street), and getting to the space is an absolute maze and none of this is explained beforehand. You have to hand full a register on the ground floor, take a lift up one floor, walk out and past a Starbucks, then go through another gate, where you will find lifts of which only one of them actually goes to the 25th floor. It took me 20 minutes to go from the entrance of the building to the entrance of the space.

The bathroom is fine, and I guess there's a view if you're into that - but it was a hazy day.

I left in an hour and went home, which for myself and most people will be significantly quieter, more productive and more comfortable. I can't believe I paid money to work here and was in half a mind to ask for a refund.
